bootstrap.unit: whole historical block with every eligible symbol/date/variant together

regime.degenerate_threshold: nonpositive/nonfinite train median or unavailable history => unknown, never inferred from test
regime.independence: distinct dates/sessions are counted, not asserted statistically independent; symbol or repeat counts do not increase independent market replications
regime.join: calendar decision date x symbol x variant; missing eligibility retained as NA, never CASH
regime.liquidity_proxy: trailing 20-session mean of Close*Volume in vendor quote/volume units; high if >= the symbol/fold train-only median, otherwise low
regime.new_strata_status: volatility/liquidity definitions are post-inference descriptive additions; no confirmatory or regime-strategy claim
regime.scope: retrospective descriptive audit of the complete frozen R1 study; no new model selection or LLM calls
regime.trend: decision Close / trailing SMA60 - 1; bull >0.02, bear <-0.02, otherwise sideways; original R1 rule
regime.volatility: sample SD of 20 past close-to-close simple returns, ddof=1; high if >= the symbol/fold train-only median, otherwise low
